skills.name: Dreamcatcher (捕梦)
skills.description: Kannazuki attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Reverie Granted (美梦赐予)
skills.line: You're the master of your dreams-all unfolds as you wish.
skills.description:
Effect exclusive. Kannazuki creates a field that lasts for 1 turn. Non-summoned entity ally target gains 2 stacks of Into the Dream for 2 turns.
Within the field, Kannazuki and the Into the Dream bearer gain 40% damage reduction, while other allies gain 20% damage reduction. ;Into the Dream (入梦) : :'''Buff''', '''Mark''': up to 2 stacks, a maximum of 1 instance of this effect can exist on the ally field. When the bearer casts a skill, reduces orb cost by 3 and consumes 1 stack.

upgrades.text: Before the turn of herself and of the Into the Dream bearer within the field, gain 1 orb.
The target gains Dream Realized in the next turn.

skills.name: Dreamweaver Tune (织梦曲)
skills.line: Fireflies nestle in the heart, dreams dock in the moonlit bay.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. Kannazuki and Into the Dream bearer gain 40% damage reduction, while other allies gain 20% damage reduction. At the start of battle, Kannazuki gains Dreams Realized (once per round only.) Each time Kannazuki creates a field, she gains 1 stack of Dream Divinity. ;Into the Dream (入梦) : :'''Buff''', '''Mark''': up to 2 stacks, a maximum of 1 instance of this effect can exist on the ally field. When the bearer casts a skill, reduces orb cost by 3 and consumes 1 stack. ;Dream Divinity (梦神) : :'''Buff''', '''Mark''': max 5 stacks, each stack grants allies in the field a 12% damage increase.. ;Dreams Realized (美梦必成) : :The bearer's initial 4-piece Soul effect probability and base probability are increased to 100% (a maximum of 1 instance of this effect can exist on the ally field excluding Kannazuki, and it is removed after activation)
